Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit

package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit
Typed editing-session surface for Cubism Editor model documents.

This package ports the official Cubism external-application editing API (protocol 1.1.0) onto Turboism's supported editor versions, which only expose integration protocol 1.0.x. The surface is session-scoped: EditSessionService.open(dev.turboism.sdk.plugin.PluginContext, dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.id.DocumentId) admits an EditSession (the official EditBegin.. EditEnd span), and the session exposes the 36 official operations through five typed families: ParameterKeyOps, ParameterStructureOps, SelectionOps, PartObjectOps, and DeformerOps.

Identity mapping is Turboism-owned throughout; the SDK never exposes com.live2d types. The official ModelUID is carried as DocumentId on EditSessionService.open(dev.turboism.sdk.plugin.PluginContext, dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.id.DocumentId); the official ObjectId / Id fields map to ModelObjectReference where the object kind is part of identification, to kinded ids (ParameterId, PartId, ArtMeshId, DeformerId, GlueId) where the kind is fixed, and to ModelObjectId where the host returns or accepts bare id lists. The runtime is responsible for routing these identities to host internals.

Everything fails closed: operations that cannot run against the connected editor build — including operations whose host bindings are not yet verified — raise EditUnavailableException or another EditSessionException subtype rather than guessing at editor internals.

The whole package is Incubating: it backs the external-application editing protocol and is not yet covered by the stable API compatibility surface. Ordinary parameter value writes do not need an edit session — use Parameter.setValue(float) instead, and CubismFacade.authoringTransactions() to group several writes into one Editor Undo unit.
